title: Watch: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel unleashes epic challenge flag toss
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel's challenge flag toss in a preseason game drew attention for its dramatic execution.
The NFL now allows coaches to designate a staff member for throwing challenge flags; Vrabel chose to do it himself.
Vrabel's successful challenge led to a fumble recovery after an overturned call in the game against the Colts.

title: 16 hospitalized after chemical incident at Mass. industrial worksite
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: 16 employees hospitalized with serious illness and eye irritation after chemical incident in Hudson.
Hudson Fire Department suspects a chemical process contributed to the illnesses at Parmenter Road site.
Firefighters from Marlborough, Stowe, Maynard, and Berlin assisted during the Hudson industrial incident.

title: 2 New England spots make NYT’s list of best Mexican restaurants
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Tuxpan Taqueria in Central Falls, Rhode Island, and Food Truck Paradise in New Haven, Connecticut, were named top Mexican restaurants.
Food Truck Paradise features 28 vendors, highlighting diverse cuisines including specialized Mexican drinks like mangonadas and avocado slushies.
Tuxpan Taqueria is praised for its standout tacos and signature chicken Milanesa torta on Portuguese rolls.

title: Are tire rotations necessary for electric vehicles?
author: John Paul
bullets: Tire rotations are necessary for electric vehicles due to their instant torque and additional weight impacting tire wear.
Electric vehicle tire life is shorter than gasoline vehicles due to characteristics like low-rolling-resistance tires.
Regular tire rotations maximize tread life and reduce tire noise, even if wear appears even.

title: Patriots place Terrell Jennings on IR, sign two more running backs
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots place running back Terrell Jennings on injured reserve, affecting competition for the third RB spot.
JaMychal Hasty and Hasan Haskins signed by Patriots after Jennings's injury; both bring NFL experience.
Myles Montgomery also placed on injured reserve; Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson remain top RBs.

title: Celtics release 2026-27 schedule: When will Jaylen Brown return to Boston?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Celtics will begin the 2026-27 NBA season with a game against the Detroit Pistons on October 20.
Jaylen Brown will make his return to Boston with the Philadelphia 76ers on January 21, 2027, after being traded.
The Celtics are set for 27 nationally televised games this season, including a Christmas Day match against the Miami Heat.

title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Payton Tolle allowed two hits over eight innings as the Red Sox beat the Blue Jays 7-0, ending a five-game skid.
Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam and contributed four RBIs to secure Boston's victory in the eighth inning.
Max Scherzer pitched five innings, allowing one run on three hits in his 3,000th career inning for the Blue Jays.

title: 7 takeaways from Patriots’ 13-13 tie with Colts in preseason opener
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Patriots and Colts ended their preseason opener with a 13-13 tie, featuring four forced turnovers by New England.
Patriots kicker Andy Borregales struggled, missing 3 of his 5 field-goal attempts, including a crucial 49-yard attempt.
New England's offensive line depth was tested as Ben Brown and Andrew Rupcich left with leg injuries during the game.

title: Cape Cod documentarian Mischa Richter creates a dreamy ode to Grateful Dead culture with ‘Summer Tour’
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Cape Cod filmmaker Mischa Richter directed 'Summer Tour,' a documentary exploring Grateful Dead culture.
The documentary follows two young Deadheads on the 2023 Dead & Co. final tour.
Richter and producer Chloë Sevigny will attend screenings, including one in Cape Cod on August 16.

title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Tiffani Faison will close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool's Errand in Fenway by November 24, after 15 years.
The closures are attributed to high operational costs, including tariffs and increased fuel charges, affecting Boston's dining scene.
Faison is seeking a new location for Sweet Cheeks and plans to relocate staff within her Big Heart Hospitality group.
